info.title: Trunk-Caster runtime HTTP API
info.description: Generated from TYPESCRIPT/api/routes.ts. Every response carries Cache-Control: no-store, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Connection: close. Non-GET methods on any path without a handler return 405 (so OPTIONS preflight fails). Request bodies are capped at 4 MiB.

get.summary: Telemetry stream (RFC 6455, server->client text frames). No snapshot on connect: a `status` frame every >=500 ms and a `globe-delta` frame every >=2000 ms, only while at least one client is open. A plain GET without Sec-WebSocket-Key is 400.
